Sandbox_RP_Enabled_tooltip: Master toggle. When enabled, all detection layers run on schedule and cull duplicate twin-spawn zombies.
Sandbox_RP_CullEnabled_tooltip: When ON, the automatic scans remove the duplicate zombies they detect. When OFF, Reaper runs in monitor-only mode: it still detects and shows candidates in the Necro tab, but removes nothing automatically (manual 'Cull selected' still works). Turn OFF if you'd rather not have Reaper culling, e.g. once the engine-side fixes are in place.
Sandbox_RP_LogCulls_tooltip: Print every cull to the server console with the @x,y,z coordinate of the culled zombie (copy-paste-friendly for /teleportto). Off by default: writing to the console is synchronous main-thread I/O, and clearing a large bloom emits one line per zombie removed. Turn it on while tuning thresholds, then back off.
Sandbox_RP_DebugContextMenu_tooltip: Adds a 'Reaper: Force full scan' option to the right-click menu on the ground. Triggers all bloom scans immediately on demand.
Sandbox_RP_SequentialThreshold_tooltip: Maximum OnlineID gap between two zombies on the same tile to be considered twins. 1 = strictly consecutive only. 2 = allows one legitimate zombie spawned between twins. Raise only if blooms are being missed.
Sandbox_RP_BloomInterval_tooltip: How long one full rotation of the three bloom scans takes. 5 = each scan runs once every 5 minutes, staggered so only one is ever walking the population. REAL minutes, measured on the wall clock: this used to be in-game minutes, which meant a short Day Length silently multiplied the scan rate (at Day Length 5, a '5 minute' interval was really 25 seconds). Lower values catch migrated blooms sooner at a small performance cost.
Sandbox_RP_SweepInterval_tooltip: How often the full population sweep runs, in real minutes. The sweep registers zombies that the birth watcher missed and ages out its record of where each zombie was born. It is a backstop, not the detector, so it can be relaxed freely; lower it only if zombies are appearing without being registered.
Sandbox_RP_ScanBudget_tooltip: How many zombies a scan inspects each tick. Scans no longer run to completion in one frame: they carry a cursor and resume next tick, so this is the knob that decides whether a scan is a stutter or a background hum. Default 200 (roughly 6,000/second at 30 ticks): a 5,000-zombie population is walked in under a second, spread thin enough to be invisible. Raise for faster detection on a strong server, lower if scans still show up in the frame time.
Sandbox_RP_StackThreshold_tooltip: If a tile+outfit bucket has at least this many zombies, anything beyond the threshold is culled regardless of ID gaps. Catches massive blooms with non-sequential IDs. Default 5.
Sandbox_RP_MaxRemovalsPerScan_tooltip: Cap on total zombies a single bloom scan may queue for removal. Keeps one scan from handing the drain queue a backlog it will spend minutes working through. Subsequent scans pick up where this one left off. Note this caps removals, not scan cost - see Scan pace for that. Default 500.
Sandbox_RP_CullsPerTick_tooltip: Detected duplicates enter a removal queue instead of being removed in one burst. This is how many the server removes per tick. Every removal is broadcast to each connected client, so a slow drain keeps big reaps from ballooning the network send buffer. Default 15 (roughly 450/second at 30 ticks): a 1500-zombie bloom clears in a few seconds.
Sandbox_RP_OutfitIdGap_tooltip: Within an outfit bucket, how large an OnlineID gap is still considered part of the same cluster. Higher = catches more dispersed twins but risks pulling in unrelated zombies. Default 15.
Sandbox_RP_OutfitMinCluster_tooltip: Minimum zombies sharing an outfit + sequential IDs + proximity before culling fires. Higher = more conservative. Default 3.
Sandbox_RP_OutfitProximity_tooltip: Maximum bounding-box width/height in tiles for an outfit cluster to count as a bloom. Larger zones (hospital ~150) won't match if this is below their size. Default 75.
